items.name: basic laser cutter
items.description: A handheld fibre-laser cutter with a slot for a power cell. It draws about a kilowatt while it cuts: enough to slice through thin aluminium; steel will laugh at it.

items.name: hand lamp
items.description: A rubber-cased hand lamp on a wrist loop, with a slot for a power cell. Switched on, it lights a few metres around you, drawing 20 watts.

items.name: screwdriver
items.description: A ratcheting screwdriver with a fistful of bits in the handle. It will take most of the ship apart, given time.

items.name: shiv
items.description: A shard of scrap ground to an edge against the deck, its grip wrapped tight. It cuts, after a fashion.

items.name: makeshift hammer
items.description: A fist of scrap lashed to a scrap handle with cord. It hits things hard, which is all a hammer has to do.

items.name: pry bar
items.description: A bar of plate hammered round and bent to a claw at one end. Long enough to lever a buckled door out of its frame.

items.name: wrench
items.description: A heavy open-ended wrench beaten out of plate. The jaw is rough, but it fits the bolts that hold the bunks and lockers to the deck.
